subject.title: fix(ci): run Telegram release QA from trusted harness

question: Should release checks allow candidate lifecycle scripts from main ancestors, `v*` tags, and exact heads of `release/*`, `release-ci/*`, `extended-stable/*`, and `tideclaw/alpha/*` before later secret-bearing trusted orchestration?
rationale: The implementation correctly isolates candidate build execution from credentials, but the permanent repository-ref allowlist is an operational security policy requiring release-CI owner intent.

options.title: Approve after exact-head proof
options.body: Accept the current allowlist once the refreshed head completes the credentialed Telegram lane and its dual-SHA evidence is inspected.

options.title: Narrow accepted candidate refs
options.body: Restrict the branch and tag allowlist before candidate lifecycle scripts may execute in the job.

options.title: Pause the draft
options.body: Keep the PR open as draft until release-CI ownership selects the permanent trust policy.

recommendation.title: Approve after exact-head proof
recommendation.body: Accept the current allowlist once the refreshed head completes the credentialed Telegram lane and its dual-SHA evidence is inspected.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and recently maintained the affected Telegram release-QA path and is the current assignee.
